mapper.select: SELECT segment_id, savings_roadmap_id, segment_no, planned_months, start_date, end_date, is_last_segment, status, created_at FROM roadmap_segment WHERE savings_roadmap_id = #{savingsRoadmapId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roadmap_segment (savings_roadmap_id, segment_no, planned_months, start_date, end_date, is_last_segment) VALUES (#{savingsRoadmapId}, #{segmentNo}, #{plannedMonths}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{isLastSegment})
